lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple columns of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-rectilinear grid posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs, forming grid-like anchor nodes along the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge along the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient from high-intensity highlights to low-intensity shadows.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two distinct elongated fusiform silhouettes, likely commensal fish, positioned ventrally to the primary torso.
